# Foca Studio
> Indie apps by Yating Lu and Raphael: Foca (Pomodoro focus timer with guided stretch breaks and ambient sounds), Dayfold (countdown and anniversary widgets), Core (interval and HIIT timer) and Tenderday (private PMDD and PMS tracker, coming soon). All ad-free on iPhone and Mac.

## Key facts
- Foca is a Pomodoro focus timer for iPhone, Mac and Android. It's ad-free on iPhone and Mac.
- After each focus session, Foca guides a short stretch (neck, shoulders, back, hands, legs, full body) with illustrations and voice guidance.
- Foca includes ambient sounds (more with Foca Plus), Auto-Run (custom rounds with Foca Plus) and focus statistics.
- In Foca, a guided stretch can be started at any time from the timer screen.
- Foca is free to download; Foca Plus is an optional monthly, yearly or one-time upgrade.
- Foca does not block apps or websites.
- Dayfold turns important dates into countdown and anniversary cards with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Free for 4 active moments; Dayfold Pro is optional.
- Core is an interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, circuits and boxing, with saved workouts, audio cues and weekly trends. Core Pro adds full history, monthly and yearly trends and CSV export.
- Tenderday (coming soon, planned December 2026) is a private PMDD and PMS tracker for iPhone: one turn of a dial logs how the day felt, with period days and notes, and a full check-in that rates 11 symptoms and 3 impacts on the 1 to 6 scale clinicians use for PMDD daily records; a calendar and Insights show when harder days come across cycles; a free PDF report gives a doctor two cycles of daily ratings. No account; data stays on the iPhone. It does not diagnose or predict.
